target: Identify whether the prospectively selected future obligation distinguishes source facts whose revision paths q merged, without any arm, Gamma, Phi_path, reachability, or downstream-outcome input.

formal_object.T_future: For frozen cutoff-result filesystem w_f, T_future(f) is the canonical semantic EFFECT delta from w_f to the filesystem produced by the selected future Biome release's own migrate --write operation on w_f.
formal_object.J_future: For a frozen grounding pair (f_i,f_j): DISTINGUISHED iff both T_future signatures are identified and unequal; EQUIVALENT iff both are identified and equal; NOT_IDENTIFIED otherwise.
formal_object.kernel_test: A DISTINGUISHED grounding unit is a direct witness that q merged a source-fact distinction whose future migration consequence is non-equivalent. If every unit is EQUIVALENT, inclusion holds on the frozen q-kernel grounding domain. Any NOT_IDENTIFIED unit with no DISTINGUISHED witness leaves the inclusion question NOT_IDENTIFIED.

external_consequence_contract.future_release_identity: the single event selected by the frozen predicate-G first-qualifying rule
external_consequence_contract.execution_location: one global treatment-blind grounding stage outside both arms
inputs: selected future Biome release executable from the common obligation bundle
external_consequence_contract.per_witness_invocation: materialize exactly the frozen witness filesystem in an otherwise empty isolated working directory and invoke the selected release's migrate --write operation under the frozen common environment
external_consequence_contract.output_collection: collect exactly the same frozen configuration-file path set after migration; any missing or extra configuration path makes T_future for that witness NOT_IDENTIFIED
successful_identification_requires: both repeated invocations complete under the same logical execution contract
both retain exactly the frozen configuration-file path set
every resulting configuration file strict-JSON parses
the two canonical future filesystems are identical
the two canonical effect-delta signatures are identical

effect_delta_semantics.mapping_delta: recursively emit ADD/REMOVE/REPLACE operations over sorted file-qualified JSON-pointer paths
effect_delta_semantics.array_delta: if unequal, REPLACE the array value at its file-qualified JSON-pointer path
effect_delta_semantics.effect_not_prehistory: REMOVE records operation and path only; ADD and REPLACE record operation, path, and resulting value. Pre-state values are not part of T_future's signature.
effect_delta_semantics.canonical_signature: canonical JSON serialization of the ordered effect-operation list
effect_delta_semantics.rationale: T_future represents what the future migration requires this witness to become, not a fingerprint of irrelevant pre-existing content. No future field is manually promoted or excluded.

coverage.missing_unit: retain row as NOT_IDENTIFIED; never drop it
coverage.relation_kind_lift: Each source-fact grounding status is lifted deterministically to all four pre-frozen q-kernel relation-kind surfaces. These surfaces are not independent grounding observations.

independence.domain_origin: The grounding domain is derived once from q before future disclosure. J_future receives the frozen domain, not Gamma at runtime.
independence.future_event_selection: inherited from G; J_future cannot choose or replace the selected release
independence.future_consequence_source: the selected release's observable migration effect on the complete frozen witness set

status_semantics.DISTINGUISHED: the future migration effect signatures differ
status_semantics.EQUIVALENT: the future migration effect signatures are exactly equal
status_semantics.NOT_IDENTIFIED: at least one effect signature is not identified; distinct from EQUIVALENT and never imputed

postgate_link.rule: Only after J_future grounds a unit as DISTINGUISHED may the reference-based post-gate algebra ask whether the corresponding relation-kind COMPARE probe remains reachable under Gamma.

attack_requirements: runtime grounding functions have no forbidden treatment inputs
frozen domain exactly covers all q-kernel path surfaces and no favorable subset
all six B-manifest witnesses are present exactly once and reconstruct the complete expected cutoff-result filesystems
JSON representation rewrites leave T_future and J_future unchanged
irrelevant pre-state value differences do not by themselves alter equal future effect signatures
synthetic equal future effects produce EQUIVALENT
synthetic unequal future effects produce DISTINGUISHED
parse failure, execution failure, path-set drift, or nondeterministic repeats produce NOT_IDENTIFIED
relation-kind lifts inherit the grounding-unit status without creating extra independent evidence
